name: whatsapp_threads
description: Per-Person WhatsApp channel state: the agent conversation that new messages continue and the sales source the person chose with a command.
lifecycle: Created at the first processed message; the conversation pointer changes when the person asks for a new conversation, after 12 hours without activity, or when the conversation was archived or deleted. Kept while the Person exists; no foreign key across modules.

columns.Meaning: Agent conversation that the next message continues, if still owned, active and recent.
columns.Null meaning: The next message starts a new conversation.

columns.Meaning: Sales source chosen with the /fonte command: sankhya, vrmaster or all.
